system.description:
A horse, pony, camel and so forth. Basic riding horse: Pe B3(4), Wi B2, Ag B2, Sp B6, Po B6, Fo B6. He B4, St B3, Re B4, MW B12. Hesitation 8. Skills: Rider Training, Foraging B2. Traits: Gelded, Docile, Obedient, Proud, plus Long-Limbed, Keen Hearing, Hooved, Ungulate. Stride 12.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 203
